title: Fixed Cutaway Flat Die and Twin Roller Pellet Mill
description: One newly authored whole fixed flat-die pellet-mill-style cutaway display. Two long ground runners carry a full lower case, four radial die-support ribs, an annular carrier and one entire horizontal annular die with thirty-two genuine through holes in two rows. A full vertical shaft and central head support a complete horizontal axle with two separate broad grooved cylindrical rollers above the flat die. The front chamber and feed collar are intentionally cut away, retaining one whole rear half-wall and flared rear feed-collar shell to expose the die and rollers; this is not an enclosed operating chamber. A complete outboard gearbox-shaped case, supported horizontal motor exterior, end cap, blank terminal box and empty front trough finish the whole machine. Every visible coordinate newly authored; no kitchen food-mill, airlock rotor or mixer mesh imported. Not a hand-cranked bowl with a sweep plate, opposed crushing rolls or concentric pocket rotor: the key structure is a pierced horizontal die beneath two radial roller bodies. One model zero scenes. Empty static illustrative art only. Hole number and broad dimensions are stylized, not a usable die grade. Lower case is a closed display solid; cutter, internal gear train, seals, electrical wiring and continuous material path are not made. No pellet production, food/feed suitability, die pressure, roller traction/contact, motion, thermal behavior, flow, throughput, drive power, mounting, engineering, manufacture or machinery safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
